author: Matthew Adam
title: Daniel Espino fans two in spotless frame as Guardians fall 9-4
desc: Daniel Espino struck out two over a perfect inning in Wednesday's 9-4 loss to the Brewers.
impact: Espino looked excellent in his long-awaited MLB debut. Once considered a top prospect before injuries, Espino has plenty of strikeout upside in his arm coming out of the bullpen. He's worth keeping tabs on in deeper fantasy leagues.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Kyle Bradish racks up 12 Ks in 7.2 innings vs. Seattle
desc: Kyle Bradish allowed one earned run on five hits and two walks while striking out 12 over 7.2 innings in Wednesday's win over the Mariners.
impact: Bradish set new season-highs in innings pitched and strikeouts in his best outing of the season. After the win, Bradish now has a 4.00 ERA and 1.51 WHIP to go with a 4-7 record across 15 starts. He is slated to make his next start against the Angels.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Blaze Alexander swipes a bag in three-hit win
desc: Blaze Alexander did his best table-setter impression while the Orioles held off Seattle.
impact: Alexander went 3-for-3 in a win over the Mariners with a walk, a run scored and a stolen base. After Wednesday's win, Alexander is batting .310 with two home runs, 19 RBI and eight stolen bases across 63 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Jackson Holliday chips in with HR as Orioles top Mariners
desc: Jackson Holliday went 1-for-3 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Mariners with a home run, a walk, two runs scored and one RBI.
impact: After Wednesday's contest, Holliday is hitting .195 with four home runs, 12 RBI, 13 runs scored and three stolen bases across 26 games. Despite the long ball, Holliday has struggled at the plate as of late, hitting just .136 over his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Gunnar Henderson leaves yard, drives in two vs. Mariners
desc: Gunnar Henderson went 1-for-4 in a win over the Mariners with a home run, one run scored and two RBI.
impact: After Wednesday's win over Seattle, Henderson is batting .225 with 15 home runs, 36 RBI, 40 runs scored and six stolen bases across 74 games. Despite the low batting average, Henderson continues to provide pop at the top of the lineup.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Daniel Schneemann is rare bright spot in loss
desc: Daniel Schneemann went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Brewers with a home run, one run scored, and four RBI while striking out twice.
impact: Schneemann's grand slam in the fourth inning was the only offense the Guardians were able to scrape together. After Wednesday's loss, Schneemann is batting .228 with six home runs, 26 RBI, 22 runs scored, and four stolen bases across 58 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Zack Littell labors as Nationals fall to Royals
desc: Zack Littell allowed four earned runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out two over five innings in Wednesday's loss to the Royals.
impact: After the 6-2 defeat, he now carries a 5.45 ERA and 1.38 WHIP with a 6-6 record across 15 games. Littell struggled with the long ball Wednesday, allowing four solo home runs in the loss. He is currently slated to take on the Phillies in his next start.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Gavin Williams torched by Brewers, tagged for seven runs
desc: Gavin Williams allowed seven earned runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out four over five innings in Wednesday's loss to the Brewers.
impact: Williams turned in a rare clunker, serving up two homers and notching only four strikeouts. After the 9-4 defeat, he now has a 3.83 ERA and 1.13 WHIP with a 9-4 record across 15 starts. His next start will come against the White Sox on Monday.

author: David Leisering
title: Sterlin Thompson belts first two career home runs Wednesday
desc: Sterlin Thompson went 3-for-4 with a pair of solo home runs on Wednesday in the Rockies' 8-6 loss to the Cubs.
impact: Thompson took Cubs' starter Javier Assad deep both times for his first two career blasts. His first came in the third inning to get the Rockies on the scoreboard and he added his second in the fifth for the Rockies' second run of the night. Thompson is batting .242 with two home runs and nine RBI through his first 24 career major league games.

author: David Leisering
title: Sean Sullivan hammered in loss to Cubs on Wednesday
desc: Sean Sullivan allowed eight runs on nine hits in four innings in his second career start on Wednesday as the Cubs defeated the Rockies, 8-6.
impact: Sullivan was done in by a seven-run second inning from the Cubs' offense as he allowed just a run on two hits in his other three innings of work. After going three scoreless in his first career start, Sullivan saw his ERA balloon to 10.29 across seven innings at the major league level after the outing. If the lefthander gets another turn in the rotation, it would come on Tuesday at home against Boston.

author: David Leisering
title: Javier Assad earns fifth win of season Wednesday
desc: Javier Assad improved to 5-1 on the season, allowing two runs on five hits over 5.2 innings, in an 8-6 Cubs' win over the Rockies on Wednesday.
impact: Assad did not walk a batter and struck out only one, but was aided by a seven-run second inning by the Cubs' offense. Both runs Assad allowed came on solo home runs - both by Sterlin Thompson - in the third and fifth innings. In his last two starts, he has allowed two runs on eight hits with a 6:1 K:BB ratio in 11.2 innings of work. All told, in 11 appearances (five starts), he has a 3.89 ERA and a 1.00 WHIP in 44 innings. If he gets another turn in the rotation, he would square off against the Mets on Tuesday.

author: David Leisering
title: Braxton Ashcraft goes six strong to earn victory Wednesday
desc: Braxton Ashcraft allowed two runs - one earned - on four hits in six innings on Wednesday, helping the Pirates to a 12-4 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Ashcraft, who improved to 6-3 on the season, walked three and struck out seven as his breakout season continues. The righthander did not allow a hit until Jonah Heim singled with two outs in the fourth. He then ran into trouble in the sixth as the A's scored two runs on three hits, a walk, and an error to end his night. Ashcraft lowered his ERA to 3.18 on the season and his seven strikeouts gave him 97 for the year - tied for fourth-most in the National League - as he continues to make a strong case for a spot on the NL All-Star team next month. He is lined up to face the Mariners on Wednesday in his next start.

author: David Leisering
title: Marcell Ozuna homers Wednesday in Pirates' victory
desc: Marcell Ozuna went 2-for-5 with a solo home run as the Pirates defeated the Athletics, 12-4, on Wednesday.
impact: There was a Marcell Ozuna sighting on Wednesday as he launched his first home run in more than a month off of Scott Barlow to lead off the seventh. The veteran slugger made his first appearance in a game since June 11 as he has quickly fallen out of favor in Pittsburgh. Ozuna, who signed late in the offseason, has had a disappointing season with the Pirates, batting just .198 with six home runs and 24 RBI in 52 games. On the plus side however, when he has played this month, Ozuna has gone 6-for-20 (.300) in six appearances as he keeps inching closer to the Mendoza line.

author: David Leisering
title: Ryan O'Hearn drives in career-high six in Pirates' win Wednesday
desc: Ryan O'Hearn finished a triple shy of the cycle by going 3-for-5 with a career-high six runs batted in on Wednesday to lift Pittsburgh to a 12-4 win over the Athletics.
impact: Playing in his 800th career game, O'Hearn started his evening by lacing a two-run double in the first off of A's starter Aaron Civale. In the fourth, he belted a two-run homer off of Jose Suarez - his 11th of the season - to extend the Pirates' lead to 7-0. O'Hearn capped off his career night with a two-run single in the seventh against Luis Medina. O'Hearn is having a great first season in Pittsburgh, batting .290 with 11 home runs and 41 RBI in 60 games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kyle Stowers drives in five runs Wednesday
desc: Kyle Stowers went 4-for-5 with two home runs, a double, two runs scored and five RBI in Wednesday's 12-4 win over the Philadelphia Phillies.
impact: Stowers showcased his power on Wednesday, racking up 11 total bases while recording his second multi-homer game of the season. After a slow start to the year, he's found his groove in June, slashing his way to a .537 slugging percentage with two doubles, one triple and four home runs across 54 at-bats.
